display_name: DURA 正交恢复源训练 CPU 与 GPU 计时
description: 对相同 512 个源 ID 的三个固定信道视图，使用真实 DURA 进行一轮纯 IQ 训练 smoke；比较 CPU batch8、GPU batch8 和 GPU batch32 的准备、训练及端到端时间。

data.representation: 512 fixed source L_s/U_s IQ pairs across fixed source epochs 21,22,23

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Speed and source numerical health only; 512-ID/one-epoch smoke, not a trained or evaluated recovery model

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA v1.0 E20/4940 and identical seeded fresh correction model
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura checks original source contract and no F/TX/target training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: original source-only DURA and source L_s/U_s IQ
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed identical first 512 training IDs; no target read or model selection

expected_artifacts: CPU, GPU batch8, GPU batch32 smoke.json timing and finite loss

dimensions: same 512 source IDs, three cached views
CPU batch8, GPU batch8, GPU batch32

rows.method: identical IQ-only temporary optimization with cpu source preparation batch 8
rows.purpose: measure actual source preparation and training time
rows.seed_notes: Same source fit, initial model and optimizer ordering; GPU and batch numerical differences possible.

rows.method: identical IQ-only temporary optimization with cuda:0 source preparation batch 8
rows.purpose: measure actual source preparation and training time
rows.seed_notes: Same source fit, initial model and optimizer ordering; GPU and batch numerical differences possible.

rows.method: identical IQ-only temporary optimization with cuda:0 source preparation batch 32
rows.purpose: measure actual source preparation and training time
rows.seed_notes: Same source fit, initial model and optimizer ordering; GPU and batch numerical differences possible.

notes: Runs are one-epoch source-only technical performance smokes and do not publish a restoration version or score target.
CPU and CUDA use same source records, loss and random ordering, FP32 TF32 off; exact model parameters are not guaranteed identical across devices or preparation batches.
Existing CPU model and its ground evaluation continue untouched.
